scope: Original AOA/PReLU/tanh/MSE form on the new good-only dataset; training budget and unspecified optimizer details are declared reconstruction choices, not recovered historical settings.
input: K+1 raw degree-valued AOAs; one fixed network per K, no padding, phase features or output projection
labels: Unscaled stored sample-MVDR labels from 1024 interference-plus-noise snapshots; no label clipping or normalization
selection: minimum selection-validation component MSE per K
conditioning: First-layer initialization and learning rate multiplied by 1/90 to condition raw degree units; forward input stays raw AOA. Same established strict baseline helper, not a new input feature.
